narr: Numerous showers and scattered thunderstorms lingered over the Coastal Bend on the morning of the 14th as an upper level disturbance interacted with deep tropical moisture over the region. Rainfall amounts averaged from 2 to 4 inches over the coastal plains with locally higher amounts up to 6 inches occurred over central San Patricio and western Refugio Counties. Heavy rainfall produced flooding in San Patricio and Nueces Counties.
ev: TX-DOT reported road closures on FM 1944 south of Sinton due to flooding. High water was also over the road on FM 1945.
Flood waters were over State Highway 188 east of Sinton.
Water covered the road on Rodd Field Road in Corpus Christi.
Water was over the frontage road of west bound South Padre Island Drive near Staples Street.
Flooding occurred in a parking lot between buildings of an apartment complex.
High water was over the road at Buford and 3rd Streets in downtown Corpus Christi.
